sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject: preserve the prior operand, owner/path, quantity-shape, relationship, and COMPLEX_READINESS repairs. The first sh:or alternative is intended to represent the non-applicable Omega branch, but its query uses FILTER (!(?omega > 20)), which is Omega <= 20 and therefore lets every applicable plating pass without establishing either b >= s or b < s. Change that alternative to require Omega > 20; retain the two Omega <= 20 alternatives with their explicit, paired b/frameSpacing comparison evidence.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the candidate encodes only the Omega <= 20 applicability split and omits the formula's required piecewise branch condition and comparison direction (b >= s versus b < s). Add explicit, non-vacuous branch-selection constraints over the canonical operand paths, ensuring each alternative requires its corresponding comparison evidence and cannot pass when branch-selection inputs are missing. Preserve COMPLEX_READINESS semantics: do not require execution of the nonlinear formula, but retain all declared operands, relationships, and the required result term.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unknown canonical benchmark IRI(s): https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#GeneratedShape_I2_023, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#I2_023_ApplicableBase, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#I2_023_BranchBGreaterEqualS, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#I2_023_BranchBLessThanS, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#I2_023_NonApplicablePlating
Semantic validator feedback: Reject. Preserve the prior branch-selection repair, but correct the owner/path structure: the dependency contract declares the plating-to-structural-member path via nltl:platingSupportedByStructuralMember, so remove the needless and undeclared nltl:hasStructuralMember indirection from the inverse ship path and from both branch queries. Each branch query must pair the ship-owned loadPatchHeight with frameSpacing on the structural member reached from the same plating node through platingSupportedByStructuralMember, while retaining explicit b >= s and b < s evidence and preventing missing branch inputs from passing. Keep all declared operands, the plating-owned result, and the ship-owned quantities; formula execution is not required for COMPLEX_READINESS. Also replace the unknown canonical IRIs used solely as generated shape identifiers (GeneratedShape_I2_023 and the I2_023_* shapes) with blank-node shapes or a non-vocabulary shape namespace; do not invent canonical vocabulary terms.

Reject. The prior branch-selection and owner/path repairs are preserved and are now present: both branches explicitly enforce Omega <= 20 with b >= s versus b < s, pair b with frameSpacing on the structural member reached from the same plating node, retain the plating-owned result, and do not execute the COMPLEX_READINESS formula. However, several declared formula operands are only checked for presence and unit in SPARQL, not constrained as canonical QUDT quantities with decimal numeric values, cardinality, and the required units: ship-owned averageIcePressure, frameSpan, loadPatchHeight, peakPressureFactor, and yieldStrength. Add owner-correct ship property constraints using appropriate quantity node shapes (and ensure the missing-operand checks cannot accept malformed or multiply-valued quantities). Also make nltl:hasPlating explicitly required on the target ship (sh:minCount 1), since the dependency contract declares it as a required relationship; retain its plating node/class constraint. No vocabulary matcher is needed because all required canonical concepts are already supplied.

Reject: preserve the prior operand, owner/path, quantity-shape, relationship, and COMPLEX_READINESS repairs. The first sh:or alternative is intended to represent the non-applicable Omega branch, but its query uses FILTER (!(?omega > 20)), which is Omega <= 20 and therefore lets every applicable plating pass without establishing either b >= s or b < s. Change that alternative to require Omega > 20; retain the two Omega <= 20 alternatives with their explicit, paired b/frameSpacing comparison evidence.
